title: The Workflow host must carry the typed review-verdict when its review/PR path is built
body: The TypeScript reconciler (cloudflare/src) has no role-result minting and no PR-body composition yet — the existing pxc finding covers porting the close-out and PR-posted review. When that port lands it must mint review_verdict (and drop the collect verdict for review-epic) exactly as internal/exec/subprocess/rolepayload.go does, and compose the PR body from the typed verdict, or the same host-drift the collect vocabulary guards against will reopen this defect on the cloud host. The field did not exist when the pxc finding was triaged.
